title: LRU Cache
microsoftNote: Hash + doubly linked list. O(1) get/put. Design round adjacent.
statement:
Design a data structure that follows the constraints of a **Least Recently Used (LRU) cache**.

Implement `LRUCache`:

- `LRUCache(int capacity)` initialize with positive size.
- `int get(int key)` return the value if present, else `-1`.
- `void put(int key, int value)` update or insert. If the number of keys exceeds capacity, evict the least recently used key.

Get and put must both be O(1) average.
constraints: At most 2 * 10^5 calls to get and put.
editorial: Map key → node. Dummy head/tail. Move to head on get/put. Evict tail.prev.
